description: Czech Public Auctions - Portál dražeb (judicial executors). List auctions run by Czech judicial executors from the official Portál dražeb: foreclosed flats, houses, land, vehicles, machinery and whole companies, with appraised value, reserve price and the discount between them, the deposit, auction dates, property address with coordinates and the published appraisal PDF. Filter by list (upcoming, ongoing, finished, pre-emption), start-date window, category, real vs movable property, region and price range; optional detail mode adds bid history, result and objections. mode=auctioneers instead exports the directory of executor offices. An empty 'ongoing' list is normal (auctions run in short windows), not an error. No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

categories.description: Restrict to these property categories. The register's own category filter is hierarchical and over-broad - asking for 'Byt' also returns its parent 'Nemovitosti' and its sibling 'Nebytový prostor' - so results are filtered again locally to exactly what you picked. Turn off 'Exact category match' below if you want the register's broader interpretation.
categories.title: Categories

counties.description: Keep only auctions whose property lies in these regions, matched on the region name as the register spells it, e.g. 'Praha', 'Jihočeský kraj', 'Moravskoslezský kraj'. Partial matches count. Lots with no published location are excluded when this is set.
counties.title: Regions (kraje)

exactCategories.description: On by default. Keeps only the categories you selected, discarding the parent and sibling categories the register adds on its own. Turn off to receive the register's broader match.
exactCategories.title: Exact category match

includeDetails.description: Fetch each auction's detail record to add bid history, result and objections. Costs one extra request per auction, so it roughly doubles a run's duration. Upcoming auctions have no bids yet, so leave this off unless you are reading finished lots.
includeDetails.title: Include bid history and outcome

itemType.description: Keep only real estate, only movable property, or both. Movable lots (vehicles, machinery, goods) usually have no address, so they cannot be placed on a map.
itemType.title: Property type

listings.description: Which of the register's lists to read. 'Upcoming' is the main one. 'Ongoing' is empty most of the time because auctions run in short windows - that is a normal result, not an error. 'Finished' and 'Pre-emption' are small rolling windows: the register does NOT keep a historical archive, so they cannot be used to research past sale prices.
listings.title: Auction lists

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxPrice.description: Highest reserve (starting) price to include, in CZK. Applied by the register itself.
maxPrice.title: Maximum reserve price (CZK)

maxResults.description: Maximum auction records to export. A lot appearing in more than one selected list is exported once, so you are never charged twice for the same auction.
maxResults.title: Max results

minPrice.description: Lowest reserve (starting) price to include, in CZK. Applied by the register itself.
minPrice.title: Minimum reserve price (CZK)

mode.description: 'Auctions' enumerates auction listings. 'Executor offices' instead exports the directory of all Czech judicial executor offices with their addresses and contact details, and ignores every filter below.
mode.title: What to export

startFrom.description: Earliest auction start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today for forward-looking lists. This also drives how the run splits its queries, so a narrower window costs fewer calls.
startFrom.title: Auction date from

startTo.description: Latest auction start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to one year ahead. The register typically holds about four months of scheduled auctions.
startTo.title: Auction date to

name: regdata_czech_auctions
